variants.title: Product Variants
variants.tooltipTitle: Set up variants in this order
variants.tooltipStep1: Define all variant types and options first (e.g. Size: S, M, L).
variants.tooltipStep2: Click Refresh in Variation Lists to rebuild the table rows.
variants.tooltipStep3: Fill SKU, prices, MOQ, and stock for each row, then Save or Publish.
variants.tooltipWarning: After you add, remove, or rename any variant or option, click Refresh again before saving or publishing. Skipping this step often causes save/publish errors because the table is out of sync.
variants.tooltipFooter: Avoid renaming or deleting variants used in past orders. Please create new options instead to protect order history.
variants.offerLockedVariants: Product variants and the variation list are locked because this product has an active offer. To modify them, first deactivate or disconnect the offer from the product.
variants.offerLockedPrices: Prices are locked because this product has an active offer. To modify prices, first deactivate or disconnect the offer from the product.
variants.variationListsTooltipBody1: This table must match your Product Variants above. Whenever you change variant types or options, click Refresh first so every combination is recorded correctly.
variants.variationListsTooltipBody2: Then complete SKU, selling price, purchase price, MOQ, and stock for each row. Do not save or publish while rows are missing or outdated as that can block product creation.
variants.variationListsTooltipFooter: For variants already used in orders, add new options instead of renaming or deleting existing ones.
variants.importVariationsTitle: Import variation list from Excel or CSV

variationImport.noticeBody: If variant types are not set up yet, import will create variant types and options from your file and fill the Variation List. If variants already exist, click Refresh in Variation Lists first so rows match. Save the product when finished.

variationImport.importNoMatch: No rows matched the current variation list. Refresh the table and check variant values or SKU.

variantGuard.policy:
Policy (order integrity):
Variants used in past orders cannot be renamed or deleted.
To continue selling, create a new option/variant and keep the old one for history.
To stop selling an option, leave it for past orders and stop using it for new sales.
variantGuard.footerMore:
...and {count} more.

To keep data integrity, delete/rename is blocked for those variants.
